_role: ROUND 34's ROLL-UP — the round's canonical adversarial record, which clause 6 of the publish bar reads at exactly this path. ⛔ IT CARRIES NO TALLIES OF ITS OWN, DELIBERATELY. Six per-lens seat records sit beside it, clause 1 sums blockers and P1s over every record at this commit, and a roll-up carrying the union of its seats' findings would count each of them twice — which the bar refuses by name. The tallies live on the seat records, where each finding is counted exactly once; this file carries the narrative.
seat: six blind seats — arithmetic, statistics, citations-and-archive, scope-and-language, hostile-referee, regression
_blind_means: Each seat was given the pinned sha and the outgoing artifact set and nothing else; told the working tree may drift and that the PIN is the subject; and forbidden research/autonomy/ (every other seat's output, the hardening state, the receipts, the ledger, the sprint notes, round33-seats and round34-prepin-seat), .claude/, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, STRATEGY.md, every *-cover-letter.md, every fusion-junction-aso-paper-redteam*.md and the guard-coverage audit. ⛔ BLINDNESS WAS SPECIFIED AS A PROPERTY OF COMMANDS RATHER THAN INTENTIONS, because a seat in an earlier, abandoned round ran an unscoped `git grep` and got back a previous seat's findings on the same diff having opened nothing: every prompt named the leaking paths and gave the scoped form `git grep -n <pattern> <sha> -- research/manuscripts research/modalities systems scripts`, and every prompt required a seat that leaked anyway to DISCLOSE it rather than discard the finding. Three seats did disclose one, and their disclosures are recorded on their own records rather than summarised away. Each seat was instructed to refute by default and told, in the words paper-hardening §4a requires verbatim, that returning no findings is a complete and expected answer.
_dispatch_shape: SIX CONCURRENT SEATS. trimcrae, 2026-09-02, in session, asked whether the round should keep running one seat at a time under a subagent_width of 1: 'There shouldn't be a limit on parallel subagents.' The five remaining seats were launched in one message; the measured cost of the serial alternative was about 150 minutes of wall clock against about 25. Recorded in autonomy-state.json under `_subagent_width_LIFTED_BY_TRIMCRAE_2026_09_02`.
central_claim: Across 190 junction-spanning 5-6-5 gapmers tiled at 38 in-frame NR4A3 fusion junctions, 87 (45.8%) let a mature wild-type parent transcript pair their whole six-nucleotide catalytic gap over at least ten contiguous base pairs, and for 61 of those the longest such duplex is with wild-type NR4A3 itself — so the binding constraint on a fusion-junction gapmer for extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma is discrimination from the design's own parents rather than designability, and that liability is largely invisible to a conventional identity-threshold off-target search. The liability is NOT shown to be specific to this disease: chimeras built at real exon termini meet the same screen at 40.6%, inside the panel's own 95% interval, and the ten-base-pair criterion is adopted rather than measured. Selecting within each junction rather than across the panel nevertheless yields two nameable reagents at the two most-reported breakpoints — 5'-GGGCATATCATCAAAC-3' at EWSR1 exon 12 and 5'-GGGCATATCTTGTGTG-3' at TAF15 exon 6, both to NR4A3 exon 3, whose longest wild-type parent gap duplexes are eight and nine base pairs against wild-type TFG — together with two screened scramble controls and a pre-registrable falsification experiment with its power and voidness conditions stated. Nothing has been synthesised or tested; all five screens address hybridisation rather than cleavage; and systemic delivery to a solid tumour remains the unsolved gate after any result the paper specifies.
_where_the_tallies_are: Zero blockers across all six seats. Seven P1s, all coverage gaps rather than defects in the paper: 3 on the statistics seat (the assumed replicate SD, the interval's sidedness, and the second site of the falsification cut), 1 each on citations-and-archive (the reference list's year/volume/pages/DOI fields bound to no fetch record), scope-and-language (the Abstract's statement of framework scope, whose Introduction sibling IS bound), hostile-referee (no binding between a named reagent's exact genomic matches and anything the paper says) and regression (the 'unambiguous GRCh38' scope repair, bound by no guard reading the journal article). The arithmetic seat filed none and said so explicitly, having probed guard coverage for every load-bearing figure it re-derived. Thirty P2s across the six, the recurring ones being the published Zenodo archive sitting one commit behind the tree and the Supplementary Information addressing the extended report rather than the journal article.
_what_the_round_agreed_on_independently: ★ THREE SEATS REACHED THE SAME TWO FINDINGS FROM DIFFERENT ARTIFACTS, WHICH IS THE SIGNAL THIS PROCESS TREATS AS REAL. (1) The Abstract states the OSWG framework's scope more broadly than the Introduction the round-27 repair corrected, and nothing guards the Abstract's version — reached by scope-and-language from the guard's site anchor, by the pre-pin regression seat from the repair's diff, and corroborated by regression from the deposited instrument record's own verbatim. (2) The Supplementary Information travelling with this submission is the extended report's SI: its section references, table numbers and superscripts all address a different document — reached independently by statistics, scope-and-language, hostile-referee and arithmetic, the last of which REFUTED the apparent reference-numbering error by showing all seven superscripts resolve correctly against the document the SI names. Neither is a wrong statement in the paper, so neither is a blocker; both are the first two items a successor should take.
_and_what_the_round_refuted: ⛔ RECORDED BECAUSE A REFUTED CHARGE THAT IS NOT WRITTEN DOWN GETS RE-RAISED. The archive missing research/manuscripts/citation_scan_cache.py looked like the round-23 broken-import defect and is not one: lint_citations.py does not import it at the deposited revision, and the module arrived in a later commit, so the published archive is internally runnable. The panel's one anti-conservative use of a nominal interval — the 'but eleven' separation, where the null falls below the lower bound — survives a junction-level design-effect correction the paper does not apply. And the deposited journal-article PDF is textually identical to the pin's, so the deposit-drift class that has bitten this repository before does not recur for this paper.
